output.one_liner: BigCommerce is a SaaS ecommerce platform providing REST and GraphQL APIs for managing products, orders, customers, carts, checkouts, and store data.

auth.notes: OAuth-based API accounts with client_id and client_secret; Store-level accounts include static access tokens usable as bearer tokens; App-level accounts generate unique tokens per store installation.

evidence.snippet: BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts to developers who wish to use BigCommerce's REST APIs

access.notes: Free developer sandbox stores available for development; production use requires paid BigCommerce plan. Create API credentials in control panel with scopes needed for your use case.

evidence.snippet: Sign up for a free BigCommerce trial store to test API calls and build integrations without affecting live data
The developer sandbox is free of charge.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: OAuth apps rate-limited with quota refreshed every 30 seconds; limits vary by store plan type (Core, Performance, etc.)

evidence.snippet: REST Store Management APIs, REST Storefront API, GraphQL Storefront API, GraphQL Admin API
You can download generated OpenAPI specification files for API references in JSON or YAML
Manage real-time events with webhooks. Use webhooks to be instantly notified of specific store events
Apps using OAuth are rate-limited based on a quota that's refreshed every 30 seconds
Docs MCP Server - Connect Cursor, Claude, or Codex to the BigCommerce developer docs via MCP

buildability.rationale: Composio toolkit already exists with 532 tools; APIs fully self-serve with free sandbox credentials, comprehensive REST and GraphQL documentation, and published OpenAPI specs.

overview_evidence.snippet: BigCommerce has several APIs that let you manage store data, authenticate customers, make client-side queries for product information, and more
We deliver our core platform and products using a SaaS model.

unknown_reasons.mcp: Pages mention BigCommerce Docs MCP Server but do not provide a repository URL
